button.text: Pair one primary button with secondary buttons so the main action stands out.
Don't use two primary buttons side by side. Competing emphasis confuses priority.
Use verb-led labels that name the action and its object (e.g. 'Verify business').
Don't use vague labels like 'Submit' or 'Click here'.
Reserve danger variant for irreversible actions. Pair with a cancel option.
Don't use danger styling for non-destructive actions.
Show a spinner and disable the button during async operations.
Don't leave the button in its default state during processing.

button-menu.text: Group related actions in a ButtonMenu when space is limited.
Don't put the primary action inside a menu. Keep it visible.
Order items by frequency of use, most common first.

text-input.text: Always pair a TextInput with a FieldLabel.
Don't use placeholder text as the only label.
Show validation errors inline below the field with FieldValidation.

select.text: Use Select for 5+ options. Use RadioGroup for 2-4 options.
Don't use Select for binary choices. Use Switch or Checkbox instead.

dialog.text: Focus the primary action button when a dialog opens.
Always provide a way to dismiss the dialog (close button or cancel).

announcement.text: Use the matching variant for the message severity (success/warning/error/info).
Don't stack multiple announcements of the same type.
